settings.text: Rosemary hair & scalp oil

Rosemary infused in natural coconut and olive oil. Massage a few drops into your scalp each day to nourish the roots, calm dryness and flakes, and help reduce breakage so hair looks thicker and fuller.

settings.lines:
Nourishes dry, itchy, flaky scalps
Helps reduce breakage for fuller-looking hair
Fresh rosemary scent that keeps hair smelling clean
For every hair type, including color-treated

settings.heading: How to use
settings.content: Put a few drops on your fingertips and massage about 3 drops into each area of your scalp: front, back, left, right and crown. Rub any oil left on your hands through the lengths. Use once a day. Do a patch test 24 hours before first use.

settings.heading: Apply
settings.text: Put a few drops on your fingertips. Split your scalp into 5 areas: front, back, left, right and crown.

settings.heading: Massage
settings.text: Massage about 3 drops into each area with your fingertips, using a gentle combing and pressing motion.

settings.heading: Repeat daily
settings.text: Rub any oil left on your hands through the lengths. Use once a day and keep going. Consistency is everything.

settings.question: How long until I see results?
settings.answer: Most people notice a calmer, more comfortable scalp within the first two weeks. Hair grows slowly and in cycles, so give it 8 to 12 weeks of daily use to judge the look of your hair. Individual results vary.

settings.question: Will it make my hair oily?
settings.answer: Use a few drops on the scalp only, not the lengths. If your hair gets oily easily, apply it in the evening and wash your hair the next morning.

settings.question: Can I use it on color-treated or curly hair?
settings.answer: Yes. It works on all hair types and textures, including color-treated, relaxed and natural hair.

settings.question: How long does one bottle last?
settings.answer: Each bottle holds 50 mL. With daily use it lasts about 1 to 2 months, depending on how much you use. That's why most customers pick the 2 or 3 bottle routine.

settings.question: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: It's made for daily use, but everyone's skin is different. Do a patch test behind your ear 24 hours before first use. Stop using it if irritation occurs. If you're pregnant, breastfeeding or under medical care, check with your doctor first.
